subject: Onsite workshop + executive dinner — logistics and catering
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Marsh <elenam@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@orionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onsite workshop + executive dinner — logistics and catering

Hi Elena — great to confirm next month’s onsite in Boston. Planning notes below and a couple of quick asks so we can lock logistics: 

Summary of ask: Redwood will host an executive dinner the evening before the customer workshop (Wed 18 Mar). We’ll also provide a light reception before dinner and block meeting rooms for the workshop on Thu 19 Mar.

What I need from you: 
- Final headcount for dinner (including any plus-ones) by EOD Thu 12 Feb
- Any dietary restrictions or allergies (vegetarian, vegan, halal, nut, shellfish, etc.)
- Preference: plated multi-course dinner vs. family-style buffet? (we recommend plated for execs)
- Do you have procurement requirements (PO, W9, vendor onboarding) for the caterer or hotel?
- Do you want alcoholic beverages at the dinner (we can arrange cash bar / hosted tab / non-alc only)?

Logistics we’re proposing: 
- Arrival: Guests to arrive ~6:00 PM for reception; dinner at 7:00 PM sharp.
- Venue option A: Grand Hotel private dining room (attached estimated cost). Venue B: on-site private room at Redwood partner restaurant (BistroCater) with plated service.
- AV: projector for a 10–15 minute welcome from your execs (we’ll coordinate slide handoff)
- Transport: we can arrange car for two visiting Orion execs from airport/hotel — please confirm names if you want pickup.

Attached: draft-invite.pdf (simple invite we can send once details locked).

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if helpful — I’m free Wed morning.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Preference: plated multi-course dinner preferred for a formal setting.
Alcohol: OK with wine only at a hosted tab, Procurement asked that any invoices go to procurement@orionhealth.com and that the vendor be able to accept a PO. They also require a signed service agreement and insurance certificate.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Onsite workshop + executive dinner — logistics and catering

All — I reached out to Marcus at the Grand Hotel and Chef Marco at BistroCater. Quick summary of options and costs below (estimates):

Option 1 — Grand Hotel private dining - Room rental: $250 (waived with food min)
- Plated three-course dinner: $95/person x 8 = $760
- Wine pairing (hosted tab): $120
- AV: in-room projector + run = $150
- Total estimate: $1,280 (includes service charge & tax)

Option 2 — BistroCater private room (partner restaurant)
- Plated three-course: $110/person x 8 = $880
- Reception passed hors d’oeuvres (30 pax equivalent): $180
- Service charge + setup: $160
- AV (bring-in): $180
- Total estimate: $1,400

Notes: 
- Both vendors can provide W9 and insurance; BistroCater prefers final menu 10 days prior; Grand Hotel can handle nut-free prep in separate station (they require allergy note on final guest list).
- Payment: both accept PO. Grand Hotel will invoice directly; BistroCater prefers payment within 30 days but will accept PO + invoice.
- Timeline: Need final headcount + menu on or before 06 Mar to secure room and special dietary prep.

Attachments: vendor-quotes.pdf (quotes from both vendors).

I recommend Grand Hotel for proximity to visiting exec rooms and simpler AV integration unless the customer prefers BistroCater’s ambiance. Approve budget? Once approved I’ll open an AP ticket and request PO details from procurement@orionhealth.com.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Events & Field Ops, Redwood Inference
